notes.title: Update and Fixes
notes.content:
[h3]Update[/h3]
[list]
[*] 5x5x5 Levels added
[*] Game tutorial added
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Black mode renamed to dark mode and their colors was improved
[*] The lines number was fixed to correct order
[*] Now when you hover any cell, the numbers relevant to this cell are slightly highlighted
[*] Now you can hover on any number to highlight the lines
[*] The achivements name was fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Hex Picross Major Update
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Everyone,

We appreciate your feedback, with it we change the game for better:[/h2]

[h3]We created a new game design, now the game is more like hexagon nonogram[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42780798/878b74f9401e11495fbeea697ae0b27ac8a64672.png[/img]

[h3]For this, all levels have been recreated:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The game continue with 240 levels
[*] The levels are separeted in 6 difficult modes
[*] The levels is no more randomic and each level create images and pictures
[/list]
[b]On this moment, 3x3x3 and 4x4x4 levels are in the game, others difficult levels will be launch on next days[/b]

[h3]Other changes that you requested:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42780798/da5145acd7025b947864f34605d2cba23c25f60d.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Now you can click on right mouse button to select a "negative" cell
[*] Now you can click on the column to highlight it
[*] Now you can resize the window mode
[/list]
[h3]A game tutorial will be added to the game soon[/h3]

For more suggestions, you can use the game community to contact us
We hope you always have a good experience with our games
